You find the question that makes a stranger set aside what they were doing and listen.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One nonhostile creature you share a language with.
Duration
The progress persists for the social task.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Utility

Ordinary conversation remains available to everyone; this ability adds a reliable way to steer it. Choose one plausible conversation objective. Make a Guile check to make progress toward the social task.

2 progress.

3 progress.
